ADAPT_REQUEST_HEADERS
Description
This event is raised as soon as any HTTP request headers have been
returned from the IVS. In the case of ICAP on the IVS, that’s when the
encapsulated HTTP headers of any modified or direct response have been
received (and can therefore be examined.) This happens only when the
IVS result is “modified” or “response” as this event does not trigger
if the IVS result is “noop” or an error.
Examples
Remove a header that should now have been encapsulated in the ICAP
response.
when
ADAPT_REQUEST_HEADERS
{
HTTP
::
header
remove
Transfer-Encoding
}
